subject: Charged twice for my order
body: I was charged twice for the same order last week and would like one of the charges refunded.

subject: Refund not received
body: I was told my refund would arrive within 5 business days, it has now been 10 days and I have not received it.

subject: Incorrect amount charged
body: My invoice shows $89.99 but I was actually charged $109.99, can you explain the discrepancy?

subject: Cancel my subscription and refund
body: I want to cancel my subscription immediately and get a refund for this month since I haven't used the service.

subject: Invoice missing from my account
body: I need last month's invoice for my accounting records but I can't find it anywhere in my billing history.

subject: Upgrade pricing question

subject: Payment method declined

subject: Currency shown incorrectly

subject: Annual plan discount not applied

subject: Still being billed after cancellation

subject: App crashes on startup
body: Every time I open the app it crashes immediately, even after reinstalling.

subject: Export feature broken
body: When I try to export my data to CSV, I get a blank file every time.

subject: Page won't load
body: The dashboard page just spins forever and never actually loads any content.

subject: Search function returns no results
body: I know there are matching items but the search bar returns nothing no matter what I type.

subject: Notifications not working
body: I stopped receiving email notifications a few days ago even though they're enabled in my settings.

subject: Images not uploading
body: Every time I try to upload a photo I get a generic error message with no details.

subject: Mobile app out of sync with desktop
body: Changes I make on the desktop app don't show up on my phone until hours later.

subject: Integration with Slack stopped working
body: Our Slack integration was working fine last week and now no messages are coming through at all.

subject: Formatting broken after update
body: After the latest update, all my documents show broken formatting with text overlapping.

subject: API returning 500 errors
body: Our integration calls to your API have been returning 500 errors intermittently since this morning.

subject: Can't log into my account
body: I've reset my password three times and I still can't get into my account.

subject: Two factor authentication not sending codes
body: I am not receiving the SMS codes needed to log in, I've tried three times in the last hour.

subject: Account locked after failed attempts
body: My account got locked after I entered the wrong password a few times, how do I unlock it?

subject: Lost access after email change
body: I changed my email address and now I can't log in with either the old or new one.

subject: Team member can't access shared workspace
body: I added a colleague to our workspace but they're getting a permission denied error when they try to log in.

subject: Password reset email never arrives

subject: Session keeps logging me out
body: I get logged out every few minutes even though I didn't click logout, it's making the app unusable.

subject: Can't change my permissions
body: I'm supposed to have admin access on our team plan but I'm only seeing viewer permissions.

subject: Single sign-on not working
body: Our company uses SSO to log in and it's been failing for our whole team since this morning.

subject: Forgot username and email
body: I haven't logged in for a year and I genuinely don't remember which email I used to sign up.

subject: Do you offer a student discount

subject: Do you have a mobile app
body: I've been using the website, is there a dedicated mobile app available too?

subject: Question about data privacy
body: Can you clarify how long you retain customer data after an account is closed?

subject: Do you support multiple languages
body: Is the platform available in Spanish, or only English right now?

subject: How do I contact sales
body: I'm interested in an enterprise plan, who should I speak with about custom pricing?

subject: General feedback on the new design
body: Just wanted to say the new interface looks great, much cleaner than before.

subject: Do you integrate with Notion
body: I use Notion heavily for my workflow, is there a native integration planned?

subject: What happens to my data if I cancel
body: If I cancel my subscription, is my data deleted immediately or kept for some time?

subject: Looking for API documentation
body: Where can I find the developer documentation for building on top of your API?

subject: Payment system down for all customers

subject: Security concern, unauthorized login

subject: Critical bug affecting all users

subject: Service outage during business hours
body: Your service has been completely unreachable for 45 minutes and our entire team is blocked from working.

subject: Duplicate charges hitting hundreds of customers
body: We are seeing reports that hundreds of our customers were double charged in the last hour due to what looks like a billing system error on your end.

subject: Production database connection failing
body: Our production environment can't connect to your database service at all right now, this is a complete outage for us.

subject: Legal deadline at risk due to platform failure
body: We have a contractual filing deadline in one hour and the export feature we depend on for this is completely broken.
